query: WizJobs targets creative-tech talent in Dubai and must differentiate from both mass job boards and portfolio networks while remaining a jobs marketplace with explainable matches and an AI companion. Research creative/design/tech talent platforms to answer one question: which portfolio-first and creative-hiring patterns from Behance, ArtStation, Dribbble, Creative Circle, Arc, Contra, and similar should inform WizJobs candidate and employer product design â€” for niche positioning against Bayt-style boards and LinkedIn. Find: (1) how Behance, ArtStation, Dribbble, Creative Circle, Arc, Contra structure discovery of talent and jobs (portfolio, project, hire, freelance, full-time); (2) portfolio-first UX patterns (work-as-profile, case studies, skill tags, social proof) that convert better than resume-only; (3) pricing, take rates, and employer hiring flows where publicly documented; (4) gaps these platforms leave for Dubai/UAE full-time creative-tech roles and visa/relocation context. Constraints: include all six named platforms where product exists; avoid conflating freelance marketplaces with full-time job boards without labeling the model. Prefer primary sources; treat forums/social as weak signal only; if sources conflict, separate fact from inference and flag what needs verification. Don't stop at the first plausible answer: corroborate each key claim with multiple independent primary sources where they exist (and say so explicitly where they don't), continuing until every numbered question is covered to that bar. Before finishing, do a self-critique pass â€” list gaps, contradictions, and any single-source claims, then run another round of searches to close them, repeating until clean. For each point, give the source link, the specific claim, and a one-line "why it matters". No marketing fluff â€” verifiable, citable facts only. Output everything into a single detailed markdown file.
